text.p: Malaysia's Transwater Corp Bhd has appointed Wan Adli Wan Ibrahim as its new executive chairman, replacing Wong Shu Pin who has relinquished both his posts as chairman and managing director of the company.
Transwater said in a statement on Thursday that Wong will continue to be a director of the company.
The appointment followed Wan Adli's proposal to acquire a 50.84 percent stake in Transwater from Berjaya Group Bhd. Wan Adli is also executive director of Berjaya Group.

Transwater announced last month that it planned to acquire a 19 percent stake in Prime Utilities Bhd and an 80 percent interest in Tioman Island Resort Bhd which would first acquire a property developer and a 3,875-acre piece of land in central Selangor state.
Transwater said the deal would transform the tiny engineering concern into a property and sewerage treatment outfit.
Prime Utilities owns Indah Water Konsortium, the concessionaire for the privatised national sewerage project.
